items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: But he always liked good drumming. He had his own drums with him. The drums would be out there. So he told me...

ctx.x: And he played a lot of the popular songs of the day?

Yeah. Whatever he played, he had a very good left hand. Something like Fats Waller. He didn't do no singing; he just played. But he always liked good drumming. He had his own drums with him. The drums would be out there. So he told me... He'd been there about ten years, in one place. That's all he used at the Frog Pond.
So the Frog Pond was a dance hall.
